summary: Azitra, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $3,503,232 of common stock under a September 28, 2026 Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sole sales agent. Shares trade on NYSE American as AZTR; the September 25, 2026 close was $0.1680, with public float near $10.5 million. A.G.P. receives a 3.0% cash fee and acts on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with no escrow. This is a routine capital-raising takedown rather than a special situation, though continued dilution and Nasdaq/NYSE American minimum-price compliance remain the watch items.
